tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background for the site and the CMS. Warm paper in light, ink-night in dark.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: CMS cards, menus, inputs, tables.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Sunken fields: fact boxes, the CMS sidebar, photo placeholders, code blocks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines between articles, table rows and sections. Decorative, never a control border.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons). At least 3:1 on paper and paper-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: headlines, article body, labels. Reads on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunken and every -soft fill (≥13:1).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text: standfirsts, photo captions, CMS table cells. On paper, paper-raised, paper-sunken (≥7:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata only: publish time, reading time, data sources, input hints. On paper, paper-raised, paper-sunken and meridian-soft (≥4.5:1).

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Identity fill: primary buttons, the masthead plate, behind the inverse logo. Flips light in the dark theme to keep contrast.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a navy fill (primary button labels, the inverse logo).

tokens.name: compass
tokens.usage: North red for UI: Latest/Live labels, the live dot, the active-section marker, correction notices. As text on paper, paper-raised, compass-soft. Keep it under ~5% of the screen.

tokens.name: compass-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind compass text (the Latest bar, live labels).

tokens.name: on-compass
tokens.usage: Text on a solid compass fill.

tokens.name: compass-mark
tokens.usage: The needle's north tip in the logo and identity shapes (cover, the pull-quote rule). Same in both themes; not a text colour (4.4:1 on paper).

tokens.name: meridian
tokens.usage: Analytical blue: section kickers, links, the Scheduled status, the focus ring, the first data series. Text on every surface and on meridian-soft (≥6.8:1).

tokens.name: meridian-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind meridian text (Scheduled badge, context highlights).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in article body, always underlined. Alias of meridian.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Published status and confirmations in the CMS. Always with a check icon and a word. Text on success-soft and paper-raised.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the Published badge and success notices.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: In review status and editorial warnings. Always with an icon and a word. Text on warning-soft and paper-raised.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the In review badge and warning banners.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Validation errors and destructive actions, CMS only; on the public site red belongs to compass. Always with an icon and a message. Text on danger-soft and paper-raised.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind error messages and delete confirmations.

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: Charts: the primary series (meridian).

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Charts: the comparison series or the highlighted value.

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Charts: third series (ochre).

tokens.name: data-4
tokens.usage: Charts: fourth series (sea green).

tokens.name: data-5
tokens.usage: Charts: averages, reference lines, or 'other'.

groups.name: Editorial
groups.note: Newsreader variable: weight 200–800, optical size 6–72. Headlines use a large opsz, body copy a text opsz.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one lead headline on the front page. Below 640px use headline-1.

styles.name: headline-1
styles.sample: Why food inflation slowed this month
styles.usage: Article page headlines and the lead card. Below 640px: 32/38.

styles.name: headline-2
styles.sample: Three things to know about the new electricity tariff
styles.usage: Front-page section heads and secondary large cards.

styles.name: headline-3
styles.sample: Central bank holds its benchmark rate
styles.usage: Standard card titles and article lists.

styles.name: standfirst
styles.sample: Farm-gate prices have dropped, but the savings have not yet reached the market.
styles.usage: The standfirst under an article headline, in ink-secondary.

styles.name: body-article
styles.sample: The decline was sharpest in the production centres of West and East Java after the main harvest.
styles.usage: Article body, column no wider than measure (680px). Below 640px: 18/29.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: We are not targeting prices, we are targeting certainty of supply.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans for navigation, labels, controls and the whole CMS.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Section label above a headline, always uppercase (text-transform: uppercase).

styles.name: ui-large
styles.usage: Section navigation and CMS panel titles.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: General interface text, CMS table cells, menus.

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, input labels, key cells.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Farmers harvest rice in Karawang, West Java. Photo: Dimas Arya/PressCompass

groups.name: Data
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono for numbers that must compare cleanly and for timestamps.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Timestamps, data sources, article IDs, slugs in the CMS.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Key figures in the FactBox and data summaries.

spacing.note: 4px base. The public site uses the larger steps for breathing room; the CMS stays between space-2 and space-5.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; kicker to headline on compact cards.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Padding inside badges and dense cells; headline to metadata.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows; horizontal padding of small buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button, input and table-cell padding; mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Desktop grid gutter, fact-box padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside an article (paragraph to image, quote).

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between front-page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Generous space above an article headline.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Before the footer and on special section covers.

radius.note: Editorial and square-cut. Photos and public cards have no radius; controls are only slightly softened.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Photos, article cards, the Latest bar, fact boxes, tables.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, status badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, menus and dialogs in the CMS.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Author photos (avatars) and the live dot only.

shadow.note: Rules before shadows. Shadows only for things that genuinely float.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Draggable CMS cards, inputs while active.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px paper gap, then a solid 2px meridian ring (≥6.8:1 on every surface). Required on every interactive element.

layout.note: 12-column grid on desktop, 4 columns on mobile.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the front page and section pages.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the article text column (~70 characters).

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Gap between grid columns on desktop; 16px on mobile.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Height of the logo row in the site header.

tokens.name: rule-heavy
tokens.usage: Heavy masthead rule under the navigation and above key sections.
